# 0001-use-gadr-as-name.md

# Use GADR as Name for Generalized ADRs

## Status

Accepted

## Context

We have been using "ADR" as the term for Architectural Decision Records, but this causes confusion with other ADR formats (like the original Michael Nygard format). We need a distinct name for our lightweight ADR format.

## Decision

We will use "GADR" (Generalized Architectural Decision Records) as the name for our lightweight ADR format.

## Consequences

- Clear distinction from other ADR formats
- Searchable term
- Pronounceable

## Consequences

- Need to update existing references
- Documentation updates required
